phase_goal: prove delivery-owner can dispatch ready tasks from canonical runtime state
entry_conditions: canonical plan, tasks, design, test-cases, and registry are finalized
exit_conditions: developer reports and verify results exist for each task

unit_priority_order.priority_basis: Default PM ordering follows the closed-loop UNIT index until a stronger business dependency is confirmed.

technical_evidence_requirements.business_invariant: The linked business result must be proven at service, data, and audit boundaries without changing excluded behavior.
technical_evidence_requirements.required_downstream_proof: Downstream design and test evidence must prove the linked AC and risk with interface, data, audit, or execution records.
